quotes.text: The real difference isn't about looks at all. It's about where you start. Canvas app start with a blank screen. You design every pixel, every button, every color.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes the canvas vs. model-driven decision around the starting point instead of appearance.

quotes.text: Model driven is not the right tool when you need pixel-perfect design. It's the right tool when you need data integrity and process consistency.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A crisp rule of thumb for when model-driven apps fit and when they do not.

quotes.text: If you need dataverse anyway, because your data is complex or you need governance or your building a system of record, then the licensing cost is the same for both app types. So pick based on functionality, not price.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clarifies a common licensing misconception that drives the wrong app choice.

quotes.text: You don't have to pick one type for your entire app. Modern Power Apps projects blend both approaches and you choose the right tool for each piece of the puzzle.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Introduces the hybrid pattern as the practical answer to the either-or question.

quotes.text: Canvas apps can get messy as they grow. Without careful structure, you end up with hundreds of formulas spread across screens.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Names the main maintenance risk of canvas apps.

chapters.title: Intro: two app types, one name

takeaways: Canvas apps start from the screen and connect to almost any data source, while model-driven apps start from a Dataverse data model and generate the UI.
Model-driven apps bring business process flows, security roles and auditing out of the box but always require premium licensing.
Most strong solutions combine both: a model-driven core for the system of record and canvas apps for specialized or mobile front-line screens.
hook: Power Apps hides two very different app types under one name, and picking the wrong one can cost weeks of rework. This episode helps makers and IT decision-makers understand canvas versus model-driven apps through use cases, licensing and a four-question decision framework.
